X7 WHAT THIS CANNOT SHOW
The identifiability rule bounds what can be FITTED; it does not create resolution.
A genuine sub-30-minute component exists or does not independently of whether this
grid can see it. This loop only stops the model claiming to have decided that.
Twelve hours caps the slow end; a day-scale memory appears as the offset C.
Bulk RNA cannot separate a coherently relaxing population from cells switching at
different times.
Two exponentials fitting better than one does NOT establish two physical memory
pools. A stretched exponential, a power law, or a distribution of rates across
genes would produce the same improvement.
